head.title: Clay and Kelsy – Music, Instruments & Design
head.description: Clay and Kelsy are a Los Angeles duo — interactive album experiences, instruments, hand-painted 3D-printed art relics. Music, Instruments & Design.

head.title: Synths, Free Plugins & Apps | Clay and Kelsy
head.description: Every instrument and effect we make, in one place. Press play on any of them.

head.title: Pro-Osc – Analog Synth for Kontakt (83 Presets)
head.description: Pro-Osc is a vintage-era analog synth sampled into a modern Kontakt instrument. 83 handcrafted presets, 30 convolution spaces, full NKS. $29.

head.title: Moo-Osc - Classic Analog Synth for Kontakt (84 presets)
head.description: Moo-Osc is built from three classic analog synths — heavy, creamy basses and timeless leads. 84 handcrafted presets for Kontakt, full NKS. $29.

head.title: Digi-Osc – Digital Synth for Kontakt (81 Presets)
head.description: Digi-Osc is built from three digital synths and eurorack modules — bright, beautiful, digital. 81 handcrafted presets for Kontakt, full NKS. $29.

head.title: JX-Osc - 80's Analog Synth for Kontakt (81 Presets)
head.description: JX-Osc is an 80s-era analog synth for Kontakt — lush strings, brass and pads with signature chorus shimmer. 81 handcrafted presets, full NKS. $29.

head.title: Chip-Osc - Chiptune & Digital Synth for Kontakt
head.description: Chip-Osc is a digital hybrid synth for Kontakt, from 8-bit chiptune to dark cinematic. 81 handcrafted presets, 20 wave shapes, full NKS. $29.

head.title: Dem-Osc - Free Synth for Mac (VST3/AU)
head.description: Download Dem-Osc for free! Five oscillators sampled from real analog and digital hardware, four convolution spaces, 25 presets. Free for MacOS.

head.title: Free Things – Free Synths & Kontakt Instruments
head.description: Instruments Clay and Kelsy made and gave away — DEM-Osc plus free Kontakt samples (gr808 kick, aGong, and more), as featured on Pianobook.

head.title: About – Clay and Kelsy
head.description: Meet Clay and Kelsy, the Los Angeles duo behind the music, the software instruments, the Songwriting app, and the designs.
